newsitem.title: USA: All American to cut staffing, some opers.
newsitem.headline: All American to cut staffing, some opers.

text.p: All American Semiconductor Inc said on Monday it is discontinuing certain unprofitable operations and its has started to reduce overall staffing.
The company did not provide information on the extent of the staff cuts or the possibility of a charge to cover them.
Also, the company's top executives voluntarily took pay cuts for the balance of 1996, All American Semi said.
"While the short term picture is unclear, we remain optimistic about the longer-term prospects for our industry and company," president and chief operating officer Bruce Goldberg said in a statement.
Company spokiesmen were not immediately available for further comment.
All American Semiconductor said it does not foresee an increase in fourth quarter sales over third quarter, a prospect which led the company to start its cost cutting program.
With the recent opening of our sales offices in Milwaukee, Seattle, Cleveland and Raleigh, N.C. complete, we will not be adding any more locations at this time, the company said.
